Thus after Ali Ibn Husain (a.s) Imamate continued in his generations one after another.

key_terms.أَعْقَابِ الْأَعْقَابِ: descendants of the descendants (indicating continuous lineage)

ai.seo_question: Who inherited the Imamate after Ali ibn al-Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kitab al-Ghayba* emphasizes the exclusivity of the Imamate within the progeny of Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s), specifically highlighting the line of Hasan al-Askari (a.s) and his descendants. It underscores the Shia belief in the unbroken chain of divine leadership (*Imamah*) passing through specific descendants, a key point of distinction from other sects. The phrase 'A'qab wa A'qab al-A'qab' signifies a continuous, hereditary succession that remains intact until the reappearance of the Twelfth Imam.
